test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the radius of the base to the height of a cylinder is 3 : 1. If its volume is 9702 cm³, then the curved surface area of the cylinder is: (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **radius (r)** to **height (h)** = 3 : 1. Let r = 3x and h = x.

Volume = πr²h ⇒ (22/7) × (3x)² × x = 9702.

⇒ (22/7) × 9x³ = 9702 ⇒ x³ = (9702 × 7) ÷ (22 × 9) = 343 ⇒ x = 7.

Radius r = 21 cm, Height h = 7 cm.

Curved Surface Area = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 7 = 924 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 924 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0d1578e8d1be046a9234cd43504e174617eddbc9f9300b63a231892a8482941.png] 

**Given:** Ratio r : h = 3 : 1, Volume (V) = 9702 cm³.

**Formula:** Volume of Cylinder = πr²h; Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh.

⇒ Let r = 3x and h = x.

⇒ (22/7) × (3x)² × x = 9702

⇒ (22/7) × 9x² × x = 9702

⇒ x³ = (9702 × 7) ÷ (22 × 9) = 343

⇒ x = √343 (cube root) = 7

⇒ r = 3 × 7 = 21 cm and h = 7 cm

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 7

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 21 = 924 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 924 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Divisibility Shortcut

Since the formula for CSA (2πrh) contains π, the answer must be a multiple of 11. In many exams, only one option satisfies this, helping to identify 924 cm² quickly.</p
